user.title: Daikin MPC (shadow mode)
user.description: Map the telemetry entities. Suggested values are pre-filled where they exist. This version only reads and learns; it never writes to the heat pump.

data.lwt: Flow temperature (water leaving the heat pump)
data.rwt: Return temperature (water coming back from the radiators)
data.elec_kwh: Total electricity used for heating, Daikin counter (kWh)
data.dhw_heat_kwh: Total heat produced for hot water (kWh)
data.buh_kwh: Total electricity used by the backup heater (kWh)
data.dhw_elec_kwh: Electricity used for hot water, Daikin counter (kWh)

data_description.ti: Living-room temperature measured by the Daikin room thermostat.
data_description.to: Outdoor temperature seen by the heat pump.
data_description.lwt: Use the R1T sensor; R2T reads −128 °C on this unit.
data_description.heat_w: Heat delivered by the heat pump, as reported by P1P2.
data_description.elec_w: Daikin's own estimate; the external meter below is more accurate.
data_description.lwt_set: Flow temperature the Daikin is currently aiming for.
data_description.dhw_active: On only while the cylinder is being heated (dhw_demand), not 'hot water enabled'.
data_description.heating_enabled: Main on/off switch for space heating.
data_description.heating_demand: On while the thermostat calls for heat (main-zone valve open). Lets the forecast know whether heating is currently requested.
data_description.heartbeat: An entity that updates every minute (e.g. the Daikin clock). If it stops, the readings are treated as stale.
data_description.ext_w: Recommended. Accurate meter on the heat pump supply, including hot water and standby.
data_description.ext_kwh: Recommended. Used to learn efficiency (COP) and standby power.
data_description.dhw_elec_kwh: Used to separate hot water from heating in the external meter.
data_description.predheat_h1: Type the entity id, e.g. predheat.internal_temp_h1. Only used to compare forecast accuracy.
data_description.solar_radiation: Weather-station radiation. Sun through the windows warms the house.
data_description.house_w: Electricity used inside the house, including the heat pump. Must exclude battery charging and include all PV supply; leave empty if no such sensor exists.
data_description.ev_w: Charging happens outside the house, so this is subtracted from the house load.
data_description.outside_w: E.g. loft IT. Subtracted from the house load (their heat does not reach the rooms).
data_description.battery_w: Battery and inverter inside the house: their conversion losses warm it.
data_description.tank_c: Tank inside the house: its standing heat loss warms it.
data_description.solcast_entities: Solcast forecast entities for today and tomorrow, comma-separated, e.g. sensor.solcast_pv_forecast_forecast_today, sensor.solcast_pv_forecast_forecast_tomorrow. Used to forecast sunny periods.

reconfigure.title: Daikin MPC: entity mapping
reconfigure.description: Change which entities are read. Learned state is kept. Empty optional fields are pre-filled with verified defaults where those entities exist.

init.title: Daikin MPC settings
init.description: Model starting values and the comfort range and prices used for recommendations. Recommendations are shown only; nothing is sent to the heat pump.

data.fallback_import_tariff: Import tariff if Predbat is not available
data.fallback_export_tariff: Export tariff if Predbat is not available
data.gain_household_factor: Share of household electricity that warms the house

data_description.room_min_c: Recommendations keep the room at or above this all day and night.
data_description.room_max_c: Recommendations never plan the room above this.
data_description.cost_basis: Battery-aware: daytime energy is valued at what it would earn if exported, or cost to store at night. Tariff: raw import prices.
data_description.fallback_import_tariff: Prices normally come from Predbat (predbat.rates). Format: 00:00-05:00=7.6, 05:00-24:00=34.87
data_description.comfort_periods: Times when the room should ideally be warmer, e.g. 07:00-09:00=21, 18:00-24:00=21. Outside them the lowest allowed temperature applies.
data_description.prior_gains_w: Gains not measured by any mapped sensor (people, appliances). About 290 W with sun, battery and tank mapped; about 440 W with none of them.
data_description.gain_household_factor: House load minus heat pump, EV and outside loads; about 0.7 of it warms the rooms (2025/26 data).
data_description.gain_solar_factor: Heat from the sun per W/m² of measured radiation; 1.5 from last winter.
data_description.gain_battery_loss_fraction: Share of battery power lost as heat inside the house; 0.045 from the Predbat loss settings.
data_description.gain_tank_ua_w_per_k: Tank heat loss per K of tank-to-room difference; about 1.5 W/K for a 180 L cylinder.

error.bad_tariff: Use HH:MM-HH:MM=price, covering the whole day.
error.comfort_outside_range: Preferred temperatures must lie between the lowest and highest allowed.
